column1: # BitBake. Rule: every top-level statement that declares something. A variable
# assignment (=, ?=, ??=, :=, +=, .=, with an override such as :append or
# :${PN}, and with export) is variable named by the variable alone; the same
# variable assigned on several lines is several symbols. Shell functions and
# tasks (do_x() {}, fakeroot do_x() {}), Python tasks and functions
# (python do_x() {}), Python def, and addtask lines are function (an addtask
# line is named by the task as written). Not definitions: setting a variable
